text: The relay brownout at 02:10 lasted eleven minutes; stock queries returned stale counts until the cache lease expired.
Spare gaskets are kept in bay nine behind the clamps.
Behind the clamps in bay nine are the spare gaskets kept.
The FLT line of intake filters shares bay 14 with gasket kit 220A and the clamps.
Fuse drawer: slow fuse, fast fuse and the fuse for the pump are counted weekly.
Filter cartridge FLT-220A fits the cold store intake and must be counted before every reservation.
A blown fuse on the intake pump is replaced from the drawer and logged in the incident report for the shift.
Error E0417 means the relay rejected a reservation because the operator lacks the outpost permission.

During the winter audit the quartermaster found one fuse missing from the drawer, two gaskets past their date, three runbooks with outdated contacts and a reservation ledger that nobody had signed for a month.
Only the quartermaster may approve a reservation that exceeds the counted stock; the request is refused and logged.
The relay runbook covers restarting the relay after a brownout: wait sixty seconds, then clear the cache.
Relay board RB/7731-K replaces the burnt controller in the relay rack; order it through the depot.
The RB depot shipment 7731 arrived with K-type clamps and a signed ledger.
